h: Ystrad Mynach and the Rhymney Valley
p: Penallta Road runs through the middle of Ystrad Mynach, a small village in the Rhymney Valley with a station on the line between Rhymney and Cardiff. It's very much a local high street, so Lucky Strike is a place locals nip into rather than a destination for visitors.

If you're around for the day, Parc Penallta on the old colliery site has walking trails and Sultan the Pit Pony, a huge earth sculpture that's best seen from the top of the hill. Llancaiach Fawr Manor, the Tudor manor house near Nelson, is a short drive away.
Over-18s only here, so bring ID if you're likely to get asked.
